title: Maqtal Me Sada Dete The Ye Sarwar e Aalam
body:
Maqtel mein sada dete the ye Sarwar-e-alam
Jeene nahi dega hame Abbas tera gham
Baba ne mujhe tumko diya tha yehi kehkar
Abbas tera saath nibhayega barabar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya baat hai kyu ruth gaya mera baradar
Soti thi jo aaram nahi payegi aankhein
Aaram se sojayegi ab jaagti aankhein
Jo band hui mere alamdar ki ankhein
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho jayegi be parda meri Zainab-e-muztar
Chin jayengey kaanao se Sakina key bhi gouhar
Chard jayega naize ki bulandi pa mera sar
Ghar lutke lejayengey bey dard sitamgar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sholoun mein badal jayega Abbas mera ghar
Balwe mein haram hoyengey be maqna-o-chadar
Barchi jigar pey khayega run mein mera akber
Hatoun pe mere teere jafa khayega Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis yaas-o-bekasi se bayan karte the Sarwar
Abid pe musibat ki ghadi aayegi bhaiya
Fouj-e-yazid uspe sitam dhayegi bhaiya
Touq-e-giraan buqar mein pehnayengey bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Uncha rahega dahair mein ghazi tera parcham
Hota rahega gham zada shabbir ka matam
Duniya bhulana payegi Abbas tera gham
Aye khuwatte bazu mere aye nasere iman
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas-e-dilawar mere Abbas meri jaan
Mazhar yehi dete the sada Sarwar-e-Zeeshan
